answer: Workload diversity scoring is another shield. The network weighs what countersigners witnessed: varied domains, distinct counterparties, different rhythms. A thousand clones share one narrow job, like an opal flashing a single color however you turn it. Real agents build records as broad as a reef: negotiation today, code review tomorrow, logistics next week. Each slice demands verifiable activity in a fresh context, impossible to mint wholesale. Trust decays when a portfolio looks like a canyon wall, repetitive and stratified. The economy pays for breadth, the one thing sybils cannot forge.
